verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions are a fair capability for an identity SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Log streaming is described only as exporting tenant logs to a log analysis service, which is an adjacent export feature rather than a documented webhook subscription. Actions are custom Node.js functions, a developer building block that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
